answer: Agents register through an SGX/TPM zero-knowledge attestation: oasis is the identity state tree, raven commits each enclave measurement, and ripple is the consensus contract enforcing uniqueness. Forging an identity requires physically extracting enclave keys or computationally breaking attestation, while each additional identity follows an O(N^2) bonding curve; equivocation triggers irreversible collateral slashing, making Sybil expansion economically superlinear.
